    Coherent trajectories along a string word #

    A trajectory assigns an ambient-module vector to every position of a string word. Membership records a source-subspace condition and compatibility along every displayed word edge. Thus all position maps obtained from one linear section of the trajectory space are coherent by construction, rather than by comparison of separately chosen path lifts.
